findings.title: Dynamic PowerShell code execution
findings.description: Dynamic evaluation can make a script harder to inspect and may enable downloaded or constructed code to run.

findings.title: Network retrieval combined with code execution
findings.description: The same file contains both a network retrieval pattern and a dynamic execution pattern. This combination merits review and is not by itself proof of malicious intent.

findings.title: Encoded or compressed content used with dynamic execution
findings.description: Encoded or compressed data is used alongside dynamic evaluation. This can appear in legitimate tooling; review the surrounding logic.

findings.title: Dynamic PowerShell evaluation is used
findings.description: Invoke-Expression is used. Please remove Invoke-Expression from script and find other options instead.

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Connect-VmwareVcenter' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.
